```lean
import BsdProject.Curves

/-- Compatibility shim: view a Weierstrass curve as an affine one. -/
abbrev _root_.WeierstrassCurve.toAffine {R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (W : WeierstrassCurve R) : WeierstrassCurve.Affine R := W

namespace BsdProject

theorem E389_point_00 : E389.toAffine.Equation 0 0 := by
  first
  | (rw [WeierstrassCurve.Affine.equation_iff]; norm_num [E389])
  | (unfold WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Equation WeierstrassCurve.Affine.polynomial
     simp [E389])
  | (simp [WeierstrassCurve.Affine.equation_iff, E389])
  | (simp [WeierstrassCurve.Affine.Equation, WeierstrassCurve.Affine.polynomial, E389])

end BsdProject
```
